# Shared fixtures for the Go-duration parser: tests/test-lib.sh (bash dur_ms)
# and tests/test_stackctl.py (stackctl.duration.dur_ms) both read this file,
# which is the whole point -- the two implementations exist on either side of a
# language boundary and must never disagree (scripts/metrics.sh's cpu_seconds
# and lib.sh's wait_healthy key off the same numbers).
#
# Format: <input><TAB><expected-milliseconds>; "#" lines are comments and the
# literal token <empty> stands for the empty string.
